morbi.headline: Morbi ceramics faces export contraction and fuel cost hikes despite container freight relief.
what_changed: Iran war disruptions caused a Rs 3,589 crore drop in ceramic exports over six months.
Propane usage resumed in the cluster, but prices rose by Rs 3/kg to reach Rs 104/kg.
Ocean container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent, offering shipping cost relief.
stress_signals: Ceramic exports plummeted by Rs 3,589 crore over six months due to the war in Iran [19f71f3185bc].
Industrial propane gas prices increased by Rs 3/kg to Rs 104/kg, raising production cost pressures [9e8c549b7c05], [3d9aa30057b8].
Tile industry faces broader export market challenges alongside rising overall cost pressures [895aa138960b].
improvement_signals: Container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent for Morbi ceramics exporters [d6c30857de2c].
what_to_watch: Further escalations in industrial propane prices above Rs 104/kg and fuel cost impact on unit margins.
Export order book recovery and receivables turnover for units trading with Middle East destinations.
Working capital utilization spikes among export-oriented tile and sanitaryware manufacturers.

surat.headline: Mixed dynamics in Surat as MMF textiles face payment stress while diamonds show selective recovery.
what_changed: MMF textile demand remains sluggish, prompting Sayan zone weavers to plan a 15-day collective vacation cutting fabric production by 60 crore meters.
Diamond processing units report improving demand and early reopening plans, though operations are constrained by rough diamond shortages and historical job losses.
Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units totaling Rs 1,521 crore in investment, while MANTRA expanded local testing services into MedTech.
stress_signals: Surat Mercantile Association warns of a severe payment crisis across the textile supply chain threatening small traders [e0787797133b].

Multiple fraud and default cases reported: Ahmedabad traders arrested for Rs 22 lakh fabric fraud [f699b1f05b5e], a trader defaulted Rs 1.5 crore to 10 jobworkers [6a3068dc8bf1], and SGCCI requested GUJCTOC action against organized textile fraud gangs [421d4bf835f5].
Sayan zone weavers plan collective shutdown to cut 60 crore meters of fabric due to ongoing financial distress [297b184838d2].
Diamond manufacturing hub recorded 100,000 job losses during the recent downturn [1bcd949a2599], alongside reports of a diamond merchant suicide in Tapi River [9edf027a29a8].
improvement_signals: Diamond cutting and polishing units report strong demand, extending operations until Dhanteras [e533595d0815] and planning early post-vacation reopening [bd78e4a130ff].
Lab-grown diamond (LGD) demand rose ahead of Diwali, leading to a 10% worker bonus [751cd1661531].
Surat Textile Policy cleared 627 units representing Rs 1,521 crore investment [021c037e28d9], while SGCCI signed two MoUs in Morocco to boost exports [472a28abf217].
what_to_watch: Monitoring receivables performance and overdue days of jobworkers and small textile merchants amid rising fraud and payment blockages.
Tracking working capital utilization and raw material availability in diamond processing units facing rough diamond supply constraints.
Observing the execution timeline, incentive disbursements, and bank credit drawdown for the 627 newly approved units under the Surat Textile Policy.
Checking Fire Department compliance status in local textile markets during festive season peak operations.
